description: The same bicubic dome clipped to x ≤ 95/32. The cut lies at u = 1/4, where the cubic basis weights are (4, 19, 8, 1, 0)/32. The surface rises towards its middle in both directions, so the surviving maximum is on the cut at v = 1/2, of height 55/16 by the tensor product of the two sets of basis weights.
